photos.desc: Abdim's stork, also known as the white-bellied stork, is a stork belonging to the family Ciconiidae. It is the smallest species of stork, feeds mostly on insects, and is found widely in open habitats

photos.file: Abdim's Stork Hawul Borno State Nigeria.2019.DSC01957.jpg
photos.desc: An Abdim's stork flying over the landscape Hawul in Borno State, North East Nigeria. This image was taken during the rainy season so the landscape looks green.
Ciconia abdimii - Abdim's stork photographed near Gaya, Niger.
Abdim's storks getting sucked into a storm by strong winds in the Etosha National Park
